mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO < 12-month MA and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it indicates a potential monetary policy mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which is a positive indicator for consumer spending and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and GDP (GDPC1) is growing, it signals a strong supply side and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO > 12-month MA and GDPC1 growth and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
